summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K on October 16, 2026, disclosing daily ASX-required reports of transactions under its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program covering Class A and Class B common stock. No per-share price, share count, or aggregate spend is stated in the excerpt; the attached exhibits (99.1, 99.2) carry the transaction detail. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is routine buyback disclosure, with repurchases subject to market price, general market conditions, securities laws, and alternative investment opportunities. Watch actual cumulative repurchase pace and any acceleration or suspension as a signal of management's capital-allocation stance.
